title: Treating head lice in a child
also: how to get rid of lice
what: Lice are tiny insects in the hair. They are not dangerous, but they cause itching and spread easily to others. They are removed with a special product and combing.
why: When your child's head itches and you can see lice or nits - white dots near the roots.
duration: treatment usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; a repeat is usually done after 7 to 10 days
tell_doctor: Your child's age, allergies and asthma
If you have already tried a product and it did not help
If there are sores or a rash on the scalp
If you are pregnant and will treat yourself

prepare.title: Product
prepare.text: Choose the product by your child's age. Ask the pediatrician or pharmacist.

prepare.title: Comb
prepare.text: You need a fine-toothed comb to remove nits.

prepare.title: Family
prepare.text: Check everyone's hair at home. Only treat those who have lice.

prepare.title: Nursery and school
prepare.text: Tell the teacher so other children can be checked.

bring: A towel and a light-colored cloth for the shoulders
steps: Apply the product to the hair, following the instructions exactly
Leave it on for as many minutes as it says
Rinse with shampoo or water, as the instructions say
Comb the hair with the fine comb, strand by strand, from the roots
Wipe the comb with a tissue after each strand
Repeat after 7 to 10 days, if the instructions say so
Wash bedding and hats in hot water
feel: It is boring for a child to sit still for long - put on a cartoon
Sometimes mild stinging of the skin from the product
after: For a few days check the head with the comb
Explain to your child not to swap combs and hats
There is usually no need to shave the head
red_flags: Rash, swelling or severe skin irritation after the product - rinse it off and see a doctor
Sores on the head with pus, or fever - see a doctor

faq.a: No. Lice spread by head-to-head contact. They also live in clean hair.

faq.q: Can my child go to nursery after treatment?
faq.a: Usually yes, after the first treatment. Ask about the rules of your nursery or school.

reminders.text: Lice treatment today. Product, fine comb, towel, good light.
